title: Remove 3D Gizmo Labels
description: Remove all labels from the 3D gizmo because they render too small to be legible. Preserve the gizmo geometry and interactions, extend existing tests, and verify the affected 3D renderer behavior.
summary: Removed all visible 3D gizmo labels in the shared React Scene gizmo, React/R3F world gizmo, and native wgpu world gizmo while preserving marker prominence, hover behavior, snapping, and hit radii. Added regression coverage. Verified 198 React world tests, the focused shared UI test, and 2 native gizmo tests. Broader UI checks retain unrelated pre-existing failures.
